purpose: Release only the unobserved second coordinate at observed scalar cells; isolate frozen inference substitution from matched-budget frontend retraining
training: Reuse the exact original 512 synthetic training inputs/extras, original Front initialization, per-seed 1024-update schedule, frozen synthetic-trained PCFI-PFN, AdamW .001/warmup16/cosine/weight_decay.01/clip1/AMP/query CE only. Two new 737-parameter arms per seed; six frontends/6144 updates. No target graph updates, extra loss, teacher or learned gate. Discard preflight one-step runs.

operators.node: Old trained full-clamp checkpoint, identical old index_add operator. First coordinate x and second coordinate0 are clamped at observed cells.
operators.partial_frozen: Reuse the old Node checkpoint, only stop clamping second coordinate0 at observed cells. No retraining.
operators.partial_trained: Same 737-parameter node/column SO2 frame network from original initialization. Clamp observed first coordinate only; second coordinate follows transport at all cells. Zero initial second coordinate,100 finite unrolled iterations,first-coordinate readout,original one PCFI channel correction/final observed clamp. Same P/confidence/descriptors/PFN. No convergence or unique inverse claim.
operators.partial_initial: Same partial operator and exact untrained initial Front for each seed. A frozen near-identity random-network control; not a broad random angle control.
operators.full_random: Full clamp with iid uniform[-pi,pi] fixed node/column angles from an episode/seed-specific private RNG; no label/feature-dependent angle selection.
operators.partial_random: Partial clamp with exactly the same deterministic random angles as full_random. No trainable frontend.
operators.signed_smooth: Same symmetric ordered-endpoint 737-parameter MLP as old clipped scalar; gain=tanh(atanh(.99)+(phi(i,j)+phi(j,i))/2),self gain1. Smooth bounds, original100-step scalar propagation/clamp/channel correction. Same parameter initialization but not identical initial forward function to Node. Saturation, derivatives and negative coefficients measured.
operators.signed: Old hard-clipped signed scalar checkpoint as reference; not newly trained.

evaluation: New 32 same-family development graphs, balanced label homo/hetero x feature smooth/rough, both context sizes and seven cases;448 episodes. Old four real development graphs/60 inputs reused without tuning. All nine arms freshly evaluated, same numeric backend and fixed PFN per seed. Primary missing-own-feature query accuracy, average masks/contexts/three fixed seeds within graph;5000 graph-paired bootstrap. NLL/Brier and nonzero-source/source2/8/full strata reported. New graph seeds are not unseen generator or independent real confirmation.
interpretation: Test the proposed boundary change, not the novelty of frames. No bank-based choice of angle range, iterations, initialization, lambda or losses. Correctness of partial observation constraints and nonzero latent coordinates does not establish predictive value. No whole-project automatic termination. No posterior/Bayes reconstruction claim. Report numeric replay separately from graph bootstrap. All previous sources/checkpoints/results preserved.
